title: Average true range
statementMd:
For `GRID`, true range of a day is the largest of: high minus low, absolute high minus previous close, absolute low minus previous close. Show the average true range over days that have a previous close, rounded to 3 decimals.

Expected columns: `atr`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH t AS (SELECT high, low, LAG(close) OVER (ORDER BY trade_date) AS pc FROM prices WHERE symbol = 'GRID') SELECT ROUND(AVG(MAX(high - low, ABS(high - pc), ABS(low - pc))), 3) AS atr FROM t WHERE pc IS NOT NULL;
```
